_about: Starting values for a NEW institution. First-run setup copies them into the institution's settings; every profile then starts from the institution's copy, and the head changes them per term. Nothing in the code depends on these values.
_periods: the start time of each period; a jump longer than the usual period length (11:00 -> 13:00) is a break that no block may run across
_room_types: the room type a lecture (L) and a practice / lab (P) block needs, unless a subject says otherwise (room_needs)
_rules: lecture_for: year = one lecture for the whole year, group = each group has its own lecture (a big year). late_periods: the last N periods of the day count as late in the quality score.
